a: Instrumental, D minor, free time with no beat and no rhythm. A soft sustained ambient pad holding a D minor chord: warm detuned organ and airy strings, a faint glassy shimmer on top, slowly breathing, gently glowing, a quiet sense of a secret about to be revealed. No drums, no percussion, no melody, no bass line, no chord changes, no build-up, no ending, the same throughout so it can loop seamlessly.
